title: Amazing
body: There is one thing that makes this app the best, it doesn’t have most features, it’s simple, doesn’t have many integrations, works with calendar’s really well, but it’s cheap and it has one time fee. I bought it because of that, and you should too because you don’t need more functionality and you also don’t need to spend a fortune on a recurring subscription for a functionally that you’ll never use.
author: Adrian_2275
